content_settings.homepage_description: Welcome to Back to Base, your mountain retreat near Nelson, BC. On 35 private acres, reconnect with your senses, nature, and yourself. Stay in private accommodations with shared spaces, enjoy wellness offerings like relaxing and deep tissue massages, and explore our walking trails, Kootenay lake, hot springs, farmers markets, sound healing, natural caves, and the towns of Nelson & Kaslo. Come and enjoy all this area has to offer—and reset your spirit.
content_settings.homepage_subtitle: We created Back to Base as a retreat for the soul. Where you can slow down, reconnect with what truly matters, and let the natural rhythm of the forest, the mountains, and the stillness guide you back to your centre. We offer just accomodations, custom private retreats specifically tailored to your needs as well as carefully curated retreats in a small group setting.                                                                                                                                                                   Back to Base - Back to your senses
content_settings.contact_address: 7640 Victor Road, Procter British Columbia, Canada
content_settings.retreat_hero_title: Activities and Practices at Back to Base1
content_settings.retreat_hero_subtitle: Where nature and quiet become part of your practic1
content_settings.retreat_intro_text: Back to Base is a place where nature and quiet become part of your practice. Everything here is designed so that any activity — from yoga to a small creative workshop — takes place in an atmosphere of calm, depth, and inspiration.
content_settings.retreat_forest_description: Just a few steps from the house, a winding path leads into the forest, where wooden platforms are hidden among tall trees. The air feels lighter here, the sound of the creek creates a natural meditation, and the soft light filtering through the canopy makes every practice deeper.
content_settings.retreat_forest_list_items: Sunrise yogaEvening meditationsBreathworkAny activity that benefits from a strong connection to nature
content_settings.retreat_indoor_title: Warm, bright indoor space at Back to Base
content_settings.retreat_indoor_description: Inside the house, there is a spacious room with large windows filled with light, warmth, and a sense of comfort — perfect for group gatherings, mini-lectures, workshops, breathwork sessions, or yoga during cooler weather.
content_settings.retreat_indoor_additional: And if you need a more intimate atmosphere or plan to use visual materials, the room can easily be darkened with blackout curtains.
content_settings.retreat_theatre_description: For presentations, educational films, documentaries, or shared viewing sessions, we offer a small but very cozy home theatre. Soft lighting, quality sound, and a calm environment help create a fully immersive experience.
content_settings.retreat_contact_title: Are you looking for a place to retreat or interested in joining a workshop?
content_settings.retreat_contact_text: Just send us a message with your preferences, and we will create a program tailored specifically for you!
content_settings.retreat_organizer_title: Are you a yoga instructor or an event organizer looking for a place to host your sessions?
content_settings.retreat_workshops_title: What workshops are our spaces suitable for?
content_settings.retreat_workshops_intro: The indoor spaces, forest platforms, and the forest itself are ideal for the following practices:
content_settings.retreat_workshops_list: Group and private yoga sessionsMeditations and mindfulness practicesSound healing and breathworkCreative and educational workshopsMini-lectures and intimate gatherings
content_settings.retreat_workshops_conclusion: Create memorable retreat experiences for your community. Nature here is not just a backdrop — it becomes a full participant. People open up more easily, rest more deeply, and return to themselves more naturally.
content_settings.retreat_collaboration_intro:
Back to Base welcomes those who create transformative practices and help people heal and restore.
We are looking for:
content_settings.retreat_collaboration_list: Program creatorsYoga instructorsMeditation teachersMassage therapistsReiki practitionersAcupuncturistsBody-oriented specialists
content_settings.retreat_collaboration_conclusion:
If you want to share your work in the quiet of the forest beside a mountain lake, we would be happy to collaborate with you.
Just call or message us!

content_settings.about_hero_subtitle: A personal retreat in the heart of British Columbia1
content_settings.about_idea_intro: Hi! My name is Rob Vuik. I founded Back to Base after twenty years of working as a co-owner of a large hotel in Nelson. When I retired, I realized something simple: many people — just like me — need a quiet place where they can rest, recover, and feel better.1
content_settings.about_idea_paragraph_1: Back to Base started as a personal retreat project, created in the forests of British Columbia near Kootenay Lake. The idea behind it is to build a place you can return to — to yourself, to silence, to simplicity, and to nature.1
content_settings.about_idea_paragraph_2: Over time, I became more and more interested in the idea of restoration and well-being. I trained as a massage therapist and now work professionally at Ainsworth Hot Springs Resort. Naturally, I'm happy to offer massage services to guests of Back to Base as well. And one more pleasant bonus: all Back to Base guests receive special rates at Ainsworth Hot Springs Resort.1
content_settings.about_idea_paragraph_3: We all get tired sometimes — work, household tasks, endless to-dos… it all wears us down. Back to Base was created to give people a chance to pause for a moment. Here, you can rest, sleep well, wander through the forest or along the shore of a mountain lake, and regain your energy.1
content_settings.about_idea_signature: I look forward to welcoming you!1
content_settings.about_location_paragraph_1: Back to Base is located in the village of Procter, 35 km from Nelson, B.C.1
content_settings.about_location_paragraph_2: You'll need to take the 24/7 Harrop–Procter ferry,1
content_settings.about_location_paragraph_3: then continue straight for another 6 minutes until you see the Back to Base sign on the right side of the road.1
content_settings.about_location_paragraph_4: From there, it's just a 3-minute drive up the mountain road — and you're here!1
content_settings.about_location_deer_warning: ???? Be careful — we have a lot of deer in the area!1
content_settings.about_attractions_lead: Discover the natural beauty and attractions surrounding Back to Base1
content_settings.about_procter_description: In the village of Procter, you'll find the Procter Café with their famous cinnamon buns, a small grocery store, and a gas station.1
content_settings.about_halcyon_description: Known for its healing sulfur waters, perfect for relaxation and rejuvenation. Back to Base guests receive special rates!1
content_settings.about_whitewater_description: Top-class slopes and excellent service for outdoor sports enthusiasts. Perfect for skiing and snowboarding.1
content_settings.about_nelson_description: A former gold-rush settlement with beautifully preserved architecture, modern restaurants, cafés, cinema, theatre, and regular concerts by visiting artists.1
content_settings.about_parks_intro: If you enjoy spending time in nature, there are many hiking trails and several provincial parks near Back to Base:1
content_settings.about_parks_list:
Kokanee Creek Provincial Park1
Kokanee Glacier Provincial Park
Lockhart Beach Provincial Park
Kianuko Provincial Park
content_settings.massage_intro: Massage is available as an add-on to your apartment rental or as a stand-alone booking.
content_settings.massage_relaxing_description: This gentle massage, perfect for those who want to unwind and restore their energy, uses smooth strokes and calming techniques that relieve stress, improve circulation, and promote relaxation. After the session, you will feel refreshed and relaxed.
content_settings.massage_deep_tissue_description: For targeted relief of muscle tension and pain, we offer deep tissue massage, designed to address chronic stiffness and discomfort in the deeper layers of muscle. It is ideal for those experiencing pain or tightness in specific areas.
content_settings.massage_reiki_description: Experience the gentle yet powerful effect of Reiki — a Japanese energy healing technique that promotes relaxation and balances the body's energy. This hands-on healing method helps remove energy blockages, restore inner harmony, and reduce stress levels.
content_settings.massage_sauna_description: After a day spent in nature, sometimes you just want to warm up. We understand how important comfort is, so we offer our guests access to a small sauna. It is located right in the house, on the basement floor.333

content_settings.room_second_description:

Computer desk.
Clothing closet
Seating area.

content_settings.room_second_note: *All tenants may use the sauna and home theatre by request, free of charge, as long as it does not disturb other guests.
content_settings.wellness_description:
Here you can book a room or wellness experience either separately or together. 
Choose from massage, sauna sessions, hot springs, sound healing, yoga etc...
content_settings.wellness_massage_description: Enhance your stay with a choise of massage options, including Reiki for energy balancing, a gentle relaxing massage, or a deep tissue massage to address specific areas of tension. Each service is designed to help you release stress and restore harmony to your body and mind.
content_settings.wellness_yoga_description: On the property, where you are surrounded by private forest, you'll find  10 platforms for yoga, meditation, group sessions, storytelling, drum circles etc...  Procter creek's whispering sound allows you to quiet your mind and focus on what really matters.
content_settings.wellness_sauna_description: Our cozy sauna is ready for you—free to use after your booked appointment. Whether you’re a guest staying with us or visiting for a massage, relax and enjoy this wellness treat.

content_settings.room_basement_description: Our spacious Loki suite on it's own private floor with a king-size bed, dining/sitting area, bathroom, walk in rain shower, kitchenette and a balcony with breakfast area overlooking Kootenay lake and surrounding mountains.

room_cards_settings.mini_hotel_title: Book a room in our mini-hotel
room_cards_settings.mini_hotel_description_1: After your relaxing massage session, why not extend your stay? Our cozy mini-hotel offers comfortable rooms and apartments where you can fully unwind and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Back to Base.
room_cards_settings.mini_hotel_description_2: Located just 35 km from Nelson, BC, surrounded by forest near Kootenay Lake with beautiful views of Mount Loki. Easy online booking — perfect for a peaceful vacation and retreat in nature.

floorplan_settings.basement_description: Our spacious Loki suite on a private floor with a king-size bed, dining/sitting area, bathroom, walk in rain shower, kitchenette and a balcony overlooking Kootenay lake and surrounding mountains.
floorplan_settings.ground_description:
Guests have access to either a private or shared bathroom (washbasin, toilet, and bathtub) located next to their room, as well as a shared washroom with shower on the lower level.

There is a shared open-concept living room, an 8-person dining area, and an open kitchen (vegetarian meals only; BBQ available for meat dishes).

A multi-purpose studio is available for wellness treatments, training sessions, meetings, presentations, dining, workshops, and more.
floorplan_settings.loft_description:
Private room with queen size bed. 
Shared bathroom with double walk in shower, double washbasin and toilet.
Sauna.
Home theatre

homepage_settings.homepage_description: Back to Base is a countryside guesthouse in Nelson, British Columbia, where you can rent a room or book the entire house for a vacation, retreat, or wellness getaway. Guests can restore their energy with a relaxing massage and enjoy comfortable accommodation surrounded by mountains and forest.22
homepage_settings.homepage_subtitle: Our cozy rooms and inspiring atmosphere make this the perfect place for solitude, meditation, yoga retreats, or simply a peaceful holiday in nature.22

room_pages_settings.room_ground_queen_subtitle: Bright room near the living room with fireplace. Ideal for two.
room_pages_settings.room_ground_twin_subtitle: Great for friends or colleagues. Close to the kitchen and massage hall.
room_pages_settings.room_second_subtitle: A private loft under the roof: bedroom, kitchenette, shower, study and balcony.

special_settings.special_hero_title: Soak & Savor at Ainsworth Hot Springs
special_settings.special_hero_subtitle: Back to Base offers its guests a unique relaxation experience. See the details below.
special_settings.special_pools_description_1: The Ainsworth Hot Springs are located just a thirty-minute scenic drive from the Back to Base lodge.
special_settings.special_pools_description_2: Relax in the mineral-rich waters of the pools and explore the unique limestone cave, where warm geothermal water flows along the grotto walls, creating a truly one-of-a-kind atmosphere for deep relaxation.
special_settings.special_dining_description_1: After your soak, enjoy a meal at the Ktunaxa Grill restaurant located on site.
special_settings.special_dining_description_2: The menu features fresh regional ingredients and creative preparation, making every dish a real delight.  Consider visiting the Spirit Water Spa, where experienced therapists offer a full range of treatments.
special_settings.special_offer_main_text: Exclusive Offer: Book a minimum 5-night stay at our Erasmus Suite (Second floor — Loft suite) and receive one free visit per person to Ainsworth Hot Springs pools, courtesy of us!
special_settings.special_offer_description: This exclusive offer includes access to the mineral-rich pools and the natural limestone cave. A perfect way to enhance your stay at Back to Base with a truly restorative experience.
